rationales: CH₄ is covalent because its atoms share electrons.
KCl is ionic because potassium transfers an electron to chlorine.
NaCl is ionic because sodium transfers an electron to chlorine.
CaO is ionic because calcium transfers electrons to oxygen.
The first period is called a very short period, not the sixth.
The sixth period is longer than a normal period.
The sixth period is longer than a long period.
The sixth period is called a very long period.
Goldstein discovered canal rays, not the proton.
J. J. Thomson discovered the electron.
Niels Bohr developed a model of the atom.
Rutherford is credited with discovering the proton.
18 g is the molar mass of water, not the mass of one molecule.
9.8 g is not the mass of one water molecule.
One water molecule has a mass of approximately 18 amu.
18 kg is not the mass of one water molecule.
Mendeleev did not arrange elements by electronic configuration.
Mendeleev arranged elements mainly in order of increasing atomic mass.
Atomic number was used in the later modern periodic table.
Completion of a subshell was not the basis of Mendeleev’s table.
An ionic bond forms by transfer of electrons between atoms.
A covalent bond forms when atoms share electrons.
A metallic bond involves attraction between metal ions and delocalized electrons.
A coordinate covalent bond forms when one atom supplies both shared electrons.
Acetic acid ionizes only partially, so it is not a strong electrolyte.
Acetic acid is a weak electrolyte because it ionizes partially in water.
Acetic acid is a weak acid, not a strong acid.
Acetic acid is an acid, not a base.
Toothpaste is generally a colloid, not a true solution.
Starch in water forms a colloidal mixture rather than a true solution.
Soap solution is generally colloidal rather than a true solution.
Ink dispersed uniformly in water is treated as a true solution in this context.
Increasing external pressure does not generally increase a liquid’s vapour pressure at a fixed temperature.
Increasing temperature increases the vapour pressure.
Greater molecular polarity generally strengthens attractions and lowers vapour pressure.
Stronger intermolecular forces generally lower vapour pressure.
NaCl melts at about 801°C, not 600°C.
NaCl melts at approximately 800°C.
1000°C is higher than the melting point of NaCl.
1200°C is higher than the melting point of NaCl.
Fluorine has the highest electronegativity among the halogens.
Chlorine is more electronegative than bromine and iodine.
Bromine is more electronegative than iodine.
Iodine has the lowest electronegativity among the listed halogens.
A mixture can be separated into its components by physical means.
A compound requires chemical methods to separate its elements.
A radical is a group of atoms or an ion, not a mixture separable by physical means.
An element cannot be separated into simpler substances by physical means.
Aluminium is the most abundant metal in Earth’s crust.
Gold is a rare metal and is not the most abundant.
Silver is much less abundant than aluminium.
Platinum is much less abundant than aluminium.
Reduction is commonly associated with the removal of oxygen.
Addition of oxygen in a chemical reaction is called oxidation.
Evaporation is a physical change from liquid to gas.
Conduction is the transfer of heat or electricity, not an oxygen-transfer reaction.
Air is a mixture of gases, so it is a gas-in-gas solution.
Gas in a solid describes a different type of solution.
Solid in a gas does not describe the composition of air.
Gas in a liquid describes a solution such as carbon dioxide in water.
